name: Residencia Temporal -- Investors and Related Personnel Subcategory

qualifying_event.description: A foreign investor (or a senior/technical staff member hired by a Chilean company in which a foreign investor holds at least 10% of voting shares) invests at least USD 500,000 in the production of goods or services, with an INVESTCHILE sponsorship letter.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: INVESTCHILE sponsorship letter; investment details document specifying purpose and amount.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum investment of USD 500,000 (or equivalent), destined to the production of goods or services.
Sponsorship letter from INVESTCHILE (Chile's foreign investment promotion agency).

requirement_groups.name: Related personnel (executives, senior managers, specialized technical staff)

requirements.blocker_text: Hired by a Chilean company in which a foreign investor holds at least 10% of voting shares or equivalent capital participation, in an executive, senior management, or specialized technical role.

outcome.duration_length: not disclosed on the fetched page; extensions require proof of investment progress and current company registration

sources.title: serviciomigraciones.cl (SERMIG) -- Investors and Related Personnel subcategory: USD 500,000 minimum investment (direct investors) or employment by a company with 10%+ foreign investor stake (related personnel); requires an INVESTCHILE sponsorship letter; applications must be submitted from outside Chile

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Chile). Modeled PUBLISHED -- the USD 500,000 threshold and INVESTCHILE sponsorship requirement are directly tier-1 sourced (SERMIG's own subcategory page). Initial permit duration was not disclosed on the fetched page and is not guessed. pr_after_months is set to 12 reflecting Residencia Definitiva's reduced timeline for 'active business investments in Chile' (see cl_permanent_residence.json) rather than a figure confirmed specifically on this page. A separate, distinct 'Business Management' subcategory (multi-entry, for recurring executive/managerial visits without a capital-investment threshold) exists alongside this one -- modeled separately as cl_business_multientry.json rather than folded in here, since it targets a structurally different applicant (frequent short visits vs. a resident investor).
